dunlop-ae2.syn: The second-generation American Elite, built for heavy V-twin cruisers and baggers. A tougher casing and a new compound aim for more miles and better rain grip, plus a smoother ride over sharp bumps.

rows.Best for: Big V-twin baggers, tourers & cruisers (Harley, Indian), solo or two-up
rows.Construction: Cut-breaker casing for heavy loads and torque; bias in most sizes, radial in a few
rows.Compound: Multi-Tread: harder long-wearing center, softer grippier shoulders
rows.Tread: New, more aggressive pattern tuned for wet traction and even wear
rows.Speed rating: H or V, depending on size
rows.Sizes: Front & rear for most Harley and Indian baggers and cruisers. Ask us for yours

dunlop-d408-d407.syn: Dunlop's Harley-branded front (D408) and rear (D407) pair, developed with Harley-Davidson and fitted at the factory on many Touring and Softail models. The go-to stock-style replacement.

rows.Best for: Harley Touring and Softail owners who want factory-style tires
rows.Construction: Bias or radial, depending on size
rows.Compound: Rear uses Multi-Tread: long-wearing center, grippier shoulders
rows.Tread: Pattern co-developed with Harley; rear D407T update aimed at more mileage
rows.Speed rating: H or V, depending on size
rows.Sizes: Harley Touring and Softail fronts & rears, 16 to 21 inch. Ask us for yours

dunlop-sportmax-roadsmart-4.syn: A sport-touring radial for riders who rack up miles but still like to carve corners. It lasts noticeably longer than the Roadsmart III, steers lighter, and grips well in the wet.

rows.Best for: Sport-touring and standard bikes, commuting to long weekend trips
rows.Construction: Radial, with a reworked sidewall for handling and comfort
rows.Compound: Multi-Tread rear; silica- and carbon-rich compounds for wet grip
rows.Tread: All-new pattern and profile for quicker, lighter steering
rows.Mileage: About 26% more rear and 23% more front mileage than the Roadsmart III
rows.Sizes: 17 and 18 inch fronts, 17 inch rears for most sport-tourers. Ask us for yours

dunlop-elite-4.syn: Dunlop's long-haul touring tire for heavyweight cruisers and baggers. Built for high mileage, with wet and dry grip that holds up loaded two-up.

rows.Best for: Touring bikes & cruisers, solo or two-up
rows.Construction: Bias-ply or radial, depending on size
rows.Compound: Dual compound rear (MT Multi-Tread): long-wearing center, grippier shoulders
rows.Tread: Sportmax-inspired pattern with long grooves that channel water away
rows.Mileage: Rear rated about 5% longer than the Elite 3
rows.Speed rating: H (up to 130 mph) on most sizes
rows.Sizes: Front & rear for most cruisers and baggers. Ask us for yours

dunlop-d404.syn: A value-priced, everyday cruiser tire that came stock on many Japanese cruisers. Steady and predictable, with a tread that clears water well. Not meant for Harley-Davidson loads.

rows.Best for: Metric cruisers, standards & vintage bikes (not Harleys)
rows.Compound: Natural/synthetic rubber blend balancing tread life and grip
rows.Tread: Offset center groove for straight-line stability; water-clearing pattern
rows.Speed rating: H (up to 130 mph) on most sizes; some sizes S
rows.Sizes: Wide range of 15 to 21 inch fronts & rears. Ask us for yours

dunlop-d401.syn: Dunlop's Harley-Davidson approved cruiser tire, with Harley branding on the sidewall. A dependable stock-style choice for Sportsters, Softails and Dynas in wet or dry weather.

rows.Best for: Harley cruisers: Sportster, Softail, Dyna and similar
rows.Construction: Bias or bias-belted, depending on size
rows.Compound: Harley-specific compound; D401T rear adds Multi-Tread dual compound
rows.Tread: Siped pattern with a profile shaped to resist cupping and wear evenly
rows.Speed rating: H (up to 130 mph) on most sizes; V on the 200/55R17 rear
rows.Sizes: 16, 17 and 19 inch Harley fronts & rears, black or whitewall. Ask us for yours

dunlop-sportmax-q5s.syn: Dunlop's top street-legal hypersport tire, replacing the Q3+. Race-derived rubber warms up fast and grips hard on the street, and it's ready for track days without tire warmers.

rows.Best for: Sportbikes and fast street riding, plus occasional track days
rows.Construction: Radial, built on Dunlop's race-tire know-how
rows.Compound: Race-derived fine-carbon compound; dual compound rear with grippier edges
rows.Tread: New pattern for faster warm-up and longer life; narrower, nimbler front
rows.Sizes: 17 inch sportbike sizes, 110/70 to 120/70 front, 140 to 200 rear. Ask us

dunlop-trailmax-meridian.syn: A road-leaning adventure tire for big ADV bikes that tour long distances but still see dirt. Strong wet grip and good wear on pavement, with enough bite for gravel and mud.

rows.Best for: Big ADV tourers like the BMW GS, Africa Twin, Tiger and V-Strom
rows.Construction: Two-ply rayon casing with a jointless belt
rows.Compound: Hi-silica for wet grip; Multi-Tread rear with a supportive center compound
rows.Tread: Adventure pattern that clears water at speed and still digs into dirt
rows.Mileage: In Dunlop's GS testing, the rear outlasted the best rival by 6% (over 15% leaned)
rows.Sizes: Common ADV fronts and rears, including 19 and 21 inch fronts. Ask us for yours

dunlop-trailmax-mission.syn: A 50/50 adventure tire built for big ADV bikes ridden hard off-road. Deep tread and wraparound side lugs grip dirt and resist rocks, while the tread lasts far longer than most knobbies.

rows.Best for: Large ADV bikes, scramblers and crossovers that see real dirt
rows.Construction: Bias or bias-belted, with thick sidewalls for puncture resistance
rows.Tread: Deep staggered-step knobs and wraparound side lugs; about 60% land
rows.Mileage: Production rear reached about 8,000 miles in Dunlop testing
rows.Sizes: Wide ADV size range with 17, 19 and 21 inch fronts. Ask us for yours

dunlop-trailmax-raid.syn: A dirt-leaning adventure tire with rally-inspired blocks, rated about 40% road and 60% off-road. Made for mid to large ADV bikes that spend more time on trails than pavement.

rows.Best for: Mid to large ADV and dual-sport bikes that ride mostly off-road
rows.Construction: Bias or radial by size, with a jointless belt and tension-controlled casing
rows.Compound: High-silica compound for wet grip and wear
rows.Tread: D908RR rally-style chevron blocks with tie bars for stability
rows.Speed rating: S or T, depending on size
rows.Sizes: 19 and 21 inch fronts, 17 and 18 inch rears. Ask us for yours

dunlop-geomax-mx14.syn: A rear-only motocross tire made for sand and mud. Tall, tightly spaced scoop knobs dig in for straight-line drive, while small fins help braking and keep it usable on firmer sections.

rows.Best for: MX riders on sandy or muddy tracks (rear tire only)
rows.Compound: New compound that flexes less, on a tougher carcass
rows.Tread: Scoop knobs 18% taller than the MX12, with fins for braking and drive
rows.Terrain: Sand and mud; soft to intermediate
rows.Sizes: Eight rear sizes, minis (10 inch) to big bikes (19 inch). Ask us for yours

dunlop-geomax-mx34.syn: Dunlop's soft-to-intermediate motocross tire, replacing the popular MX33. Bigger rear center blocks drive harder out of corners, and a wider-spaced front sheds mud.

rows.Best for: MX racers and trail riders on soft, loamy or wet tracks
rows.Construction: New carcass material for more stable performance
rows.Compound: Updated front compound for more traction and durability
rows.Tread: Rear center blocks 11% taller and 44% wider; wider-spaced front blocks
rows.Sizes: 17 sizes front & rear, minis to full-size bikes. Ask us for yours

dunlop-geomax-mx53.syn: Dunlop's intermediate-to-hard motocross tire, at its best on hard-packed tracks. A claw-shaped front knob cluster bites for braking and turning, and the compound is built to resist chunking.

rows.Best for: MX riders on hard-packed and intermediate tracks
rows.Compound: Durability-focused compound with fine carbon for grip
rows.Tread: Claw-shaped front knob cluster; flexing block-in-a-block knobs
rows.Sizes: Full front & rear lineup for most dirt bikes. Ask us for yours

dunlop-geomax-at82.syn: An all-terrain off-road tire that replaces the AT81, made for cross-country and enduro riding. The rear can be mounted either direction to suit soft or hard ground.

rows.Best for: Cross-country, enduro and off-road riders on mixed terrain
rows.Construction: Bias, tube-type; reinforced knobs and a reworked carcass
rows.Tread: Taller knob profile; rear can mount either way: scoop or flat side forward
rows.Terrain: Mixed: scoop direction for soft-int., flat direction for int.-hard
rows.Sizes: 21 inch fronts, 18 and 19 inch rears. Ask us for yours
